full_prompt_en: A square nocturnal painting places a small dark house on a raised grassy mound beside a winding path. The path enters from the lower right, curves left across the foreground, and climbs toward the house near the center. Two bare narrow trees flank the structure, their fine branches reaching into a wide blue-green night sky. A small pale moon glows in the upper left above layered clouds, while distant water or mist opens across the left horizon. Two tiny figures stand together on the path at the left edge of the mound, providing a human measure for the isolated house. The house itself is nearly black, with a few barely visible windows and a steep roofline. Dark teal, navy, and muted green fill the ground and sky; pale cream moonlight gives the clouds and path their quiet glow. Brush texture remains subtle, with soft gradients in the sky and more broken dry strokes in the grass and earth. Light comes from the moonlit upper left and spreads diffusely, leaving the house and trees as silhouettes and letting the path read as a slightly lighter ribbon. No text is visible. The overall composition is spare and still, using the curving route and high blue air to make the small dwelling feel remote and mysterious.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形夜景绘画把一座深色小屋放在隆起草丘上的弯曲小路旁。小路从右下进入，横过前景向左弯，再攀向中央附近的小屋。两棵狭窄无叶树立在建筑两侧，细枝伸入宽阔的蓝绿色夜空。左上方一轮小浅月在层云上方发亮，远处水面或薄雾沿左侧地平线敞开。两个极小人影并肩站在草丘左缘的小路上，为孤立小屋提供人的尺度。屋子几乎全黑，只能隐约看到几扇窗和陡屋顶线。深青、海军蓝和暗绿填满地面与天空；浅奶油色月光让云和小路安静发亮。笔触肌理低调，天空是柔和渐变，草地与土面则有较破碎的干笔痕。光从月亮所在的左上方漫散，让屋与树成为剪影，让小路成为稍浅的色带。没有文字。整体构图稀疏而静止，以弯曲路径和高远蓝色空气使小屋显得偏远而神秘。
style_prompt_en: Nocturnal painting favors broad blue-green atmosphere, softened cloud bands, and small near-black silhouettes. Deep teal, navy, muted green, and pale cream form a narrow cool palette. A small high light source diffuses across the upper field, brightening a winding pale passage while leaving upright forms dark. Smooth sky transitions meet drier broken marks in lower areas, creating quiet material variation. A generous open upper region and one curving lower route lead toward a compact focal cluster. The image feels still, remote, and gently mysterious.
style_prompt_zh: 夜景绘画偏爱宽阔蓝绿空气、柔化云带与小型近黑剪影。深青、海军蓝、暗绿和浅奶油色组成狭窄冷色域。一处高位小光源沿上部漫散，照亮蜿蜒浅色通道，竖向形体则留在深暗中。平滑天空过渡遇到下部较干涩破碎的笔痕，形成安静的材料变化。充裕敞开的上部和下方一条弯曲路径引向紧凑焦点聚合。画面静止、偏远且温和神秘。
theme_en: A small dark house on a winding path beneath a moonlit blue sky
theme_zh: 月夜蓝天下弯曲小路尽头的深色小屋
name: Gertrude Abercrombie
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
